items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Pete was playing there. Peter Boccage.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Charlie was playing there. He had his teeth pulled out this spring too, but I think he had his teeth this time.
Oh, yes. Oh, yes. Pete was playing there. Peter Boccage. He must have put it, given up, you know.
Go ahead, you were talking about Bunk when you went to Bunk to take lessons?
